configuration: Composed Gemini Live + OpenClaw system with connected personal stores and delegated tools.
sources_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2604.03486v2 — system design, implementation, studies, discussion, and limitations.
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.03486v2 — Appendix C, page 15; prompt omitted from the HTML extraction.
agent/main.py — instructions, gateway delegation, result retention, and relay verification.
gateway/src/server.ts; gateway/src/store.ts; gateway/src/provision.ts — task ledger, session continuity, and hosted-backend provisioning.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Camera and speech content are saved as retrievable notes, lifelogs, and personal-store entries.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Stored lists, personal records, and earlier task results inform answers and subsequent assistance.
M->A.locator: [Paper §6.3, Recall; §6.4, Interaction Evolves with More Personal Data](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.03486v2)

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Delegated search and browser tasks specify which external information to acquire.
A->S.quote: Search the web or look up information

M->S.label: insufficient
M->S.rationale: Recall informs assistance; retained priors are not shown guiding sensory sampling, attention, compression, or interpretation.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Decisions, delegated tasks, and execution results remain available in memory logs for cross-session recall.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Retained decision and task records support service recall, beyond researchers' analysis.
record.quote: reviewed past decisions or delegated tasks through accumulated memory logs.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Earlier agent-task results are retained and retrieved in subsequent sessions.
outcome.quote: to retrieve results from earlier sessions.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: Result reporting and a duplicate-cart warning do not establish outcome-based checking of the responsible service decision.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Skill growth lacks stated service authorship; accumulated personal content is not mechanism revision.
revision.locator: [Paper §6.4, Interaction Evolves with More Personal Data; §7, Models and Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.03486v2)

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Later personalized interactions are reported, but no run under a service-authored mechanism revision is identified.
later_use.locator: [Paper §6.4, Interaction Evolves with More Personal Data; §7, Models and Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.03486v2)

notes: The pinned repository contains a newer LiveKit/Anthropic Managed Agents backend: agent/main.py:1–12 and OpenClawBridge.swift:3–5 identify this transition. Its relay verification and hosted-memory configuration were not transferred to judgments about the named OpenClaw configuration.
